title: Car Shampoo — 4 L
description: Concentrated car shampoo with a pH-neutral formula that safely removes road grime, bird droppings and traffic film without stripping wax. Produces a rich foam and leaves a streak-free finish. One cap per bucket.

title: Microfibre Wash Kit — 3-piece
description: Three-piece microfibre kit includes a wash mitt, a large drying towel (60×90 cm) and a detailing cloth. Ultra-soft fibres lift dirt without scratching paintwork. Machine washable.

title: Wheel Wrench Set — 4-piece
description: Heavy-duty cross wheel wrench set with four sockets: 17, 19, 21 and 23 mm. Chrome-vanadium steel with ergonomic cross-handle for maximum torque. Fits most passenger cars and SUVs.

title: Hydraulic Floor Jack — 2 500 kg
description: Compact aluminium floor jack with 2 500 kg capacity. Low-profile entry (85 mm) makes it ideal for modern low-slung cars. Lift range 85–380 mm. Includes safety bypass valve. Weight: 5.9 kg.

title: Digital Tyre Pressure Gauge
description: Backlit digital tyre pressure gauge with 0.1 bar resolution. Reads in bar, PSI, kPa and kgf/cm². Includes bleed valve for deflating over-inflated tyres. AAA battery included.

title: Cold Degreaser — 4 L
description: Water-based cold degreaser for engines, underbodies and workshop floors. Dissolves grease, oil and tar without aggressive chemicals. Biodegradable formula. Dilute 1:5 for general use.

title: Windshield Washer Fluid — ready-mix 3.5 L
description: Ready-mixed windshield washer fluid effective down to −20 °C. Removes road grime, insects and light frost without streaking. Anti-corrosion formula safe for all washer systems. 3.5 L bottle with pour spout.

title: Bike Repair Stand — foldable
description: Foldable aluminium bike repair stand adjustable from 105 to 170 cm. Rotating clamp holds frames from 22 to 40 mm. Holds up to 30 kg. Folds flat for storage. Fits road, mountain and e-bikes.

title: Bike Chain Lubricant — 100 ml
description: All-season chain lubricant with PTFE additive for smooth, quiet shifting. Penetrates deep into chain links and repels water and dirt. Suitable for derailleur and hub-gear bikes. Drip applicator.

title: Bike Multi-Tool — 16 functions
description: Compact pocket multi-tool with 16 functions: hex keys 2–8 mm, Torx T25, flat and Phillips screwdrivers, spoke key and chain tool. Folded size 100×35 mm. Ideal for on-the-road repairs.

title: Inner Tube 700C × 23–32 — Presta valve
description: Standard replacement inner tube for road and gravel bikes. Fits 700C rims with 23–32 mm tyre width. Butyl rubber for low permeation. Presta valve (48 mm). Check tyre before fitting.

title: Floor Pump with Gauge — dual valve
description: Alloy floor pump with built-in pressure gauge (0–11 bar / 0–160 PSI). Dual-head chuck fits Presta and Schrader valves without adapters. Ergonomic T-handle. Max pressure 11 bar.

title: Garden Rake Set — 3-piece
description: Three-piece garden rake set including a 14-tine steel lawn rake, a 10-tine leaf rake and a small hand rake. Fibreglass handles for lightness and durability. Ergonomic grip ends.

title: Bypass Pruning Shears
description: High-carbon steel bypass shears with non-stick coated blade for clean cuts on stems up to 20 mm. Sap groove prevents blade sticking. Soft-grip handles with safety lock. Replaceable blade.

title: Deck & Patio Cleaner — 4 L
description: Ready-to-use deck and patio cleaner that removes green algae, moss and weathering grey. Suitable for treated and untreated wood, composite decking and stone. Apply with brush or sprayer, rinse after 10 min.

title: Reinforced Garden Hose — 25 m
description: Three-layer reinforced PVC hose with brass connectors. Inner diameter 12.5 mm, working pressure up to 8 bar. Kink-resistant. Supplied with tap connector, nozzle and hose clip.

title: Lawn Repair Seed — 1 kg
description: Fast-germinating lawn repair mix with ryegrass and fescue. Fills bare patches in 5–7 days under good conditions. Anti-bird coating. Covers up to 35 m². Suitable for sun and semi-shade.

title: Outdoor Furniture Cleaner — 500 ml spray
description: Ready-to-spray cleaner for garden furniture in plastic, aluminium, rattan and teak. Dissolves mould, green algae and winter staining. No rinsing required on hard surfaces. UV-stable formula.

title: Premium Charcoal — 10 kg
description: FSC-certified hardwood charcoal that lights quickly and burns hot (up to 800 °C) with minimal ash. Long burn time of 3+ hours. No added chemicals. Suitable for kettle grills, kamado and open grills.

title: Kettle Grill — ø 57 cm
description: Classic porcelain-enamelled kettle grill with 57 cm cooking grate (2 548 cm²). Hinged cooking grate for easy charcoal top-up. Adjustable dampers top and bottom. Removable ash catcher. Height 97 cm.

title: Gas Grill — 4 burners
description: Four-burner gas grill with stainless steel burners and 10 200 W total power. Porcelain-enamelled cast-iron cooking grates (70×46 cm). Side burner, warming rack, grease tray and thermometer included.

title: Grill Tool Set — 5-piece stainless
description: Five-piece stainless steel grill set: long-handled spatula, tongs, fork, basting brush and cleaning brush. Handles stay cool during grilling. Hanging loops for storage. Dishwasher safe.

title: Charcoal Briquettes — 10 kg
description: FSC-certified briquettes with consistent size and shape for even heat distribution. Burn time 2.5–3 hours per load at a steady 250–280 °C. Low smoke, low ash. Ideal for low-and-slow cooking.

title: Outdoor Extension Cable — 25 m H07RN-F
description: Heavy-duty outdoor extension cable with IP44-rated rubber casing (H07RN-F). 25 m, 3×1.5 mm² conductor, max 2 500 W / 10 A. Single socket with protective lid. Suitable for lawnmowers, pressure washers and outdoor lighting.
